description_expanded: This lovely Alys Beach vacation home overlooks Arboleda Park and features a quiet, serene location. Guests will find a spacious outdoor courtyard with open and covered seating and an outdoor gas fireplace. The first level features the family room, dining area and open kitchen with a large center island as well as a half bath. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a king-sized bed and walk-in shower. A second bedroom offers a king-sized bed, private bath and a balcony overlooking the courtyard. Completing the second floor, guest will find the third bedroom with a queen-sized bed, small balcony overlooking the park and access to the third full bath. A twin-sized bed is located in an alcove of the hallway. Climbing to the third floor, guest will find two different open rooftop patios featuring several seating options for enjoying the sun. The laundry area as well as parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
